Oil tanker attacked off Sharjah, 22 Indian crew safe

A Panama-flagged oil tanker, MT GEM NO. 2, was hit in a drone attack at Sharjah Anchorage on October 9. All 22 Indian crew members aboard the vessel were reported to be safe. Union Minister for Shipping Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed the safety of the seafarers.
